_meta.description: UNCCD (United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification) per-country status

primarySources.prais: https://prais.unccd.int (UNCCD Performance Review and Assessment of Implementation System)

fields.annex: Regional implementation annex: I=Africa, II=Asia, III=LAC, IV=Northern Mediterranean, V=Central & Eastern Europe, null=non-affected developed
fields.affectedParty: Designated as an affected country Party under the Convention (subject to NAP obligations)
fields.ldnTargetSet: Has voluntarily set Land Degradation Neutrality targets via UNCCD's LDN Target Setting Programme (TSP)
fields.napSubmitted: Has submitted at least one National Action Programme (NAP) under UNCCD
fields.ratifiedDate: Date of ratification / accession to UNCCD
fields.sources: Primary URLs supporting the above flags

_meta.compiledBy: Manual integration from UNCCD secretariat public datasets

ae.commitmentZh: 已设定 LDN 目标，国家行动方案聚焦土壤盐碱化与防风林。
ae.commitmentEn: LDN targets set; NAP focuses on soil salinization and shelterbelt forests.

ao.commitmentZh: 通过 TSP 设定 LDN 目标；NAP 覆盖南部干旱省份。
ao.commitmentEn: LDN targets via TSP; NAP covers southern arid provinces.

ar.commitmentZh: 已设定 LDN 目标；巴塔哥尼亚干旱半干旱地区受影响。
ar.commitmentEn: LDN targets set; Patagonia drylands designated as priority.

at.commitmentZh: 缔约国但非受影响国，主要以财政方式支持发展中国家防治荒漠化。
at.commitmentEn: Party but non-affected; supports developing countries via finance and technical cooperation.

au.commitmentZh: 非受影响发达国家；国内通过《国家干旱协议》和 Future Drought Fund 应对旱地退化。
au.commitmentEn: Non-affected developed country; addresses dryland degradation domestically via National Drought Agreement and Future Drought Fund.

bd.commitmentZh: 西北部 Barind 区域为重点；LDN 目标涵盖造林与可持续农业。
bd.commitmentEn: Northwest Barind tract prioritized; LDN spans afforestation and sustainable agriculture.

be.commitmentZh: 非受影响国，作为欧盟成员通过欧盟联合 NAP 履行。
be.commitmentEn: Non-affected; participates via EU joint implementation under the UNCCD.

bo.commitmentZh: Altiplano 高原与 Chaco 干旱区为重点；LDN 与气候适应规划协同。
bo.commitmentEn: Altiplano and Chaco drylands prioritized; LDN integrated with climate adaptation.

br.commitmentZh: 东北部 Caatinga 半干旱区是国家行动重点；2024 年更新 LDN 目标。
br.commitmentEn: Northeast Caatinga semi-arid region is the priority; LDN targets updated 2024.

ca.commitmentZh: 非受影响发达国家；通过 IDRC、Global Affairs Canada 支持发展中国家土地恢复。
ca.commitmentEn: Non-affected developed country; supports developing-country land restoration via IDRC and Global Affairs Canada.

cd.commitmentZh: 盆地森林退化、加丹加省土壤侵蚀是 NAP 优先领域。
cd.commitmentEn: Forest degradation and Katanga soil erosion are NAP priorities.

ch.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；通过 SDC 资助 Sahel、Central Asia 防荒漠化项目。
ch.commitmentEn: Non-affected; SDC funds anti-desertification programmes in the Sahel and Central Asia.

cl.commitmentZh: Atacama、Coquimbo 旱地是核心；LDN 与林业治理结合。
cl.commitmentEn: Atacama and Coquimbo drylands are core; LDN linked to forestry governance.

cn.commitmentZh: 三北防护林、库布齐治沙模式为国际样板；2030 LDN 目标已纳入'十四五'生态规划。
cn.commitmentEn: Three-North Shelterbelt and Kubuqi model are global benchmarks; 2030 LDN integrated into the 14th Five-Year ecological plan.

co.commitmentZh: Guajira、Caribbean 干旱区为重点；LDN 与森林保护结合。
co.commitmentEn: Guajira and Caribbean drylands prioritized; LDN integrated with forest protection.

cr.commitmentZh: Guanacaste 太平洋沿岸干燥森林为重点；2024 年 LDN 进度报告已提交。
cr.commitmentEn: Guanacaste dry Pacific forests prioritized; 2024 LDN progress report submitted.

cu.commitmentZh: 东部干旱省份为重点；LDN 与有机农业转型衔接。
cu.commitmentEn: Eastern arid provinces prioritized; LDN aligned with organic agriculture transition.

cz.commitmentZh: 南摩拉维亚旱化加剧，已设 LDN 目标但未单独提交 NAP（按欧盟联合实施）。
cz.commitmentEn: Southern Moravia drying intensified; LDN targets set, NAP implemented via EU joint action.

de.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；通过 BMZ、GIZ 在 Sahel/AU Great Green Wall 提供大额资金支持。
de.commitmentEn: Non-affected; major bilateral funder of Sahel/AU Great Green Wall via BMZ and GIZ.

dk.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；Danida 支持 Sahel 与 Horn of Africa 土地恢复。
dk.commitmentEn: Non-affected; Danida funds Sahel and Horn of Africa land restoration.

do.commitmentZh: 西部边境干旱区为重点；LDN 与森林恢复挂钩。
do.commitmentEn: Western border drylands prioritized; LDN linked to forest restoration.

dz.commitmentZh: 撒哈拉绿色长城非洲段牵头国之一；LDN 与造林计划深度绑定。
dz.commitmentEn: Co-leader of the Sahara/Sahel Great Green Wall; LDN deeply tied to afforestation.

ec.commitmentZh: Manabí、Loja 干旱区与 Galápagos 干燥灌丛为重点。
ec.commitmentEn: Manabí, Loja drylands and Galápagos dry scrub prioritized.

eg.commitmentZh: 尼罗河三角洲盐碱化、绿色尼罗河走廊为优先；2024 主办 COP15 邻邦协调会。
eg.commitmentEn: Nile Delta salinization and Green Nile Corridor prioritized; hosted regional coordination at COP15.

es.commitmentZh: 西班牙 75% 国土面临荒漠化风险；2024 更新 NAP，重点在 Almería、Murcia 与 Castilla–La Mancha。
es.commitmentEn: 75% of territory at desertification risk; NAP updated 2024 focusing on Almería, Murcia and Castilla-La Mancha.

et.commitmentZh: 绿色遗产倡议 (Green Legacy) 累计种植 320 亿株树；LDN 与气候韧性整合。
et.commitmentEn: Green Legacy Initiative planted 32B+ seedlings; LDN integrated with climate resilience.

fi.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；通过 MFA Finland 在东非与 Central Asia 支持土地治理。
fi.commitmentEn: Non-affected; MFA Finland supports land governance in East Africa and Central Asia.

fj.commitmentZh: 小岛屿发展中国家；甘蔗地土壤退化与海岸侵蚀为重点。
fj.commitmentEn: Small Island Developing State; sugarcane soil degradation and coastal erosion prioritized.

fr.commitmentZh: 本土非受影响；通过 AFD 是 Great Green Wall 主要捐助国之一。
fr.commitmentEn: Mainland non-affected; AFD is among the lead donors to the Great Green Wall.

gb.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；FCDO 通过气候基金支持非洲与南亚土地恢复。
gb.commitmentEn: Non-affected; FCDO supports African and South Asian land restoration via climate finance.

gh.commitmentZh: 北部 Savannah 区为重点；LDN 与森林造林计划 (FIP) 协同。
gh.commitmentEn: Northern Savannah zone prioritized; LDN aligned with Forest Investment Programme.

gr.commitmentZh: 克里特、东爱琴海与色萨利平原为重点；2023 大火后 LDN 再评估。
gr.commitmentEn: Crete, East Aegean and Thessaly plain prioritized; LDN reassessed after 2023 wildfires.

hu.commitmentZh: 大平原中部受荒漠化威胁；LDN 与匈牙利气候适应战略对接。
hu.commitmentEn: Central Great Plain at risk; LDN aligned with Hungary's climate adaptation strategy.

id.commitmentZh: 东努沙登加拉、西帝汶旱地与采矿迹地恢复为重点；LDN 与 FOLU Net Sink 2030 衔接。
id.commitmentEn: East Nusa Tenggara drylands and mine-area restoration prioritized; LDN tied to FOLU Net Sink 2030.

ie.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；通过 Irish Aid 支持东非土地治理。
ie.commitmentEn: Non-affected; Irish Aid supports East African land governance.

il.commitmentZh: Negev 沙漠绿化与滴灌为国际范例；LDN 已纳入国家长期规划。
il.commitmentEn: Negev greening and drip irrigation are global benchmarks; LDN built into long-term national planning.

in.commitmentZh: 目标到 2030 修复 2600 万公顷退化土地；2019 COP14 主办国。
in.commitmentEn: Target to restore 26M hectares of degraded land by 2030; hosted COP14 (2019).

iq.commitmentZh: 美索不达米亚平原盐碱化与南部沙尘暴为最大挑战；LDN 与水资源恢复挂钩。
iq.commitmentEn: Mesopotamian salinization and southern sand-storms are top challenges; LDN linked to water restoration.

ir.commitmentZh: 国土 80% 为旱地；LDN 与 Urmia 湖恢复、沙尘源治理结合。
ir.commitmentEn: 80% of land is dryland; LDN tied to Lake Urmia recovery and sand-storm source control.

it.commitmentZh: 西西里、撒丁、巴西利卡塔南部为重点；2024 更新 NAP。
it.commitmentEn: Sicily, Sardinia and southern Basilicata prioritized; NAP updated 2024.

jm.commitmentZh: Hellshire、St. Catherine 南部干旱海岸为重点。
jm.commitmentEn: Hellshire and southern St. Catherine arid coast prioritized.

jp.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；JICA 是亚洲与非洲土地恢复主要双边捐助方。
jp.commitmentEn: Non-affected; JICA is a leading bilateral funder of land restoration in Asia and Africa.

ke.commitmentZh: 目标到 2032 实现 10% 树覆盖；LDN 与旱地畜牧业转型挂钩。
ke.commitmentEn: Target 10% tree cover by 2032; LDN linked to dryland livestock transition.

kh.commitmentZh: Tonle Sap 流域与东北部为重点；LDN 与森林监测系统衔接。
kh.commitmentEn: Tonle Sap basin and northeast prioritized; LDN linked to national forest monitoring.

kr.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；2011 COP10 主办国；通过 KOICA 支持蒙古、东非 LDN。
kr.commitmentEn: Non-affected; hosted COP10 (2011); supports Mongolia and East Africa LDN via KOICA.

kz.commitmentZh: Aral Sea 干涸区为重点；LDN 与 Saxaul 林修复挂钩。
kz.commitmentEn: Aral Sea seabed prioritized; LDN linked to Saxaul forest restoration.

lk.commitmentZh: 北部 Mannar、东部 Trincomalee 干燥区为重点。
lk.commitmentEn: Northern Mannar and eastern Trincomalee dry zones prioritized.

ma.commitmentZh: Great Green Wall 北线牵头；阿特拉斯南麓为重点。
ma.commitmentEn: Co-leader of Great Green Wall North line; south Atlas foothills prioritized.

mm.commitmentZh: Dry Zone（曼德勒、马圭、实皆）为重点。
mm.commitmentEn: Central Dry Zone (Mandalay, Magway, Sagaing) prioritized.

mn.commitmentZh: 国土 76% 受荒漠化影响；'十亿棵树'计划 (2021–2030) 与 LDN 同步。
mn.commitmentEn: 76% of land affected; Billion Trees programme (2021-2030) aligned with LDN.

mx.commitmentZh: 北部沙漠扩张、Yucatán 半岛干燥化为重点；LDN 与 Sembrando Vida 协同。
mx.commitmentEn: Northern desert expansion and Yucatán drying prioritized; LDN aligned with Sembrando Vida.

my.commitmentZh: 受土壤酸化、油棕扩张引起的退化为重点。
my.commitmentEn: Soil acidification and oil-palm expansion-driven degradation prioritized.

mz.commitmentZh: Gaza、Inhambane 南部干旱区为重点。
mz.commitmentEn: Southern Gaza and Inhambane drylands prioritized.

ng.commitmentZh: 北部 11 州的萨赫勒边缘为最严重；Great Green Wall 旗手国之一。
ng.commitmentEn: 11 northern Sahelian states most affected; flagship Great Green Wall country.

nl.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；通过 DGIS 支持 Sahel 与 Horn of Africa。
nl.commitmentEn: Non-affected; DGIS supports Sahel and Horn of Africa programmes.

no.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；NORAD 通过气候与林业基金支持土地恢复。
no.commitmentEn: Non-affected; NORAD funds land restoration via climate and forest initiatives.

np.commitmentZh: Terai 平原与中山区水土流失为重点；社区林业为标志性手段。
np.commitmentEn: Terai plain and middle-hill soil erosion prioritized; community forestry is the signature tool.

nz.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；通过 MFAT 支持太平洋岛国 LDN 项目。
nz.commitmentEn: Non-affected; MFAT supports Pacific Island LDN programmes.

pe.commitmentZh: 沿海沙漠与 Sierra 高地为重点；LDN 整合到 Plan Bicentenario。
pe.commitmentEn: Coastal desert and Sierra highlands prioritized; LDN integrated into Plan Bicentenario.

pg.commitmentZh: 采矿迹地恢复与海岸侵蚀为重点；与 Pacific Islands Forum 协调。
pg.commitmentEn: Mine-area restoration and coastal erosion prioritized; coordinated through Pacific Islands Forum.

ph.commitmentZh: Cordillera 山区与 Mindanao 干旱区为重点；LDN 与国家绿化计划衔接。
ph.commitmentEn: Cordillera highlands and Mindanao drylands prioritized; LDN linked to National Greening Programme.

pk.commitmentZh: 俾路支、辛德 Tharparkar 为重点；2024 Living Indus 倡议把 LDN 纳入流域治理。
pk.commitmentEn: Balochistan and Sindh's Tharparkar prioritized; 2024 Living Indus integrates LDN with basin governance.

pl.commitmentZh: Wielkopolska 中部农业干旱为重点；LDN 与国家森林计划协同。
pl.commitmentEn: Central Wielkopolska agricultural drought prioritized; LDN aligned with National Forest Programme.

pt.commitmentZh: Alentejo、Algarve 为重点；2024 NAP 更新强调火后恢复。
pt.commitmentEn: Alentejo and Algarve prioritized; 2024 NAP update emphasizes post-fire recovery.

ro.commitmentZh: Dobrogea、Oltenia 南部为重点；2024 启动'国家防风林'。
ro.commitmentEn: Dobrogea and southern Oltenia prioritized; 2024 'National Shelterbelt' launched.

ru.commitmentZh: Kalmykia、Astrakhan 与外贝加尔为重点；未通过 TSP 设定正式 LDN 目标。
ru.commitmentEn: Kalmykia, Astrakhan and Trans-Baikal prioritized; has not set formal LDN targets via TSP.

sa.commitmentZh: Saudi Green Initiative 计划种植 100 亿棵树；2024 主办 UNCCD COP16（利雅得）。
sa.commitmentEn: Saudi Green Initiative plans 10B trees; hosted UNCCD COP16 (Riyadh, 2024).

se.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；Sida 资助 Sahel 与 Horn of Africa 长期项目。
se.commitmentEn: Non-affected; Sida funds long-term Sahel and Horn of Africa programmes.

sg.commitmentZh: 缔约国但非受影响（城邦无农牧业退化）；通过财政与技术合作支持。
sg.commitmentEn: Party but non-affected (city-state with no agricultural land degradation); supports via finance and technical cooperation.

sn.commitmentZh: Great Green Wall 西线核心；Ferlo 牧区为重点。
sn.commitmentEn: Core of Great Green Wall West axis; Ferlo pastoral zone prioritized.

th.commitmentZh: 东北 Isaan 高原盐土与森林退化为重点；'King's Initiative' 旱地恢复为旗舰。
th.commitmentEn: Isaan plateau saline soils and deforestation prioritized; 'King's Initiative' dryland restoration is the flagship.

tr.commitmentZh: 国土 60% 受荒漠化影响；Konya 盆地、东南安纳托利亚为重点；2024 NAP 更新。
tr.commitmentEn: 60% of land affected; Konya basin and southeast Anatolia prioritized; NAP updated 2024.

tz.commitmentZh: Dodoma、Singida 中央干旱区为重点；与 AFR100 倡议结合。
tz.commitmentEn: Dodoma and Singida central drylands prioritized; aligned with AFR100.

ua.commitmentZh: 南部草原与战争破坏土壤为重点；2024 重启 LDN 监测。
ua.commitmentEn: Southern steppe and war-damaged soils prioritized; LDN monitoring restarted in 2024.

us.commitmentZh: 非受影响国；USAID 与 USDA 国际项目支持非洲与中亚 LDN。
us.commitmentEn: Non-affected; USAID and USDA international programmes support African and Central Asian LDN.

uy.commitmentZh: 北部 Cuchilla 干燥草原与牧场为重点。
uy.commitmentEn: Northern Cuchilla dry grasslands and pastures prioritized.

uz.commitmentZh: Aral 海盆地、Karakalpakstan 为最严重；2018 设立 Aralkum 沙漠造林基金。
uz.commitmentEn: Aral Sea basin and Karakalpakstan most affected; Aralkum afforestation fund established 2018.

vn.commitmentZh: 中部沿海、湄公河三角洲盐碱化为重点。
vn.commitmentEn: Central coast and Mekong Delta salinization prioritized.

za.commitmentZh: Karoo、Northern Cape 干旱区为重点；LDN 与水土保持立法挂钩。
za.commitmentEn: Karoo and Northern Cape drylands prioritized; LDN tied to soil & water conservation legislation.
